description: Proposed 60-task bank; vectors pending host review/execution.

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Return true exactly when Kind is the ordinal string "premium"; do not lowercase or trim raw data.
Return true exactly when Term is "annual"; term text remains raw data.
Return true only for Active status.

tasks.title: Check whether an invoice is open

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Return true only for Open invoices.
Return true when signed Int64 unit price is zero or positive.
Return 1000 basis points for premium customers and zero for every other raw Kind.
Apply a 10% discount only to premium balances; truncate fractional minor units toward zero.

tasks.title: Check whether a balance is nonnegative

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Return true when signed Money balance is greater than or equal to zero.
Compare DateTimeOffset instants, not source text; equality after UTC normalization is false.

tasks.title: Check the inclusive seven-day renewal window

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Return true iff Active and expiry is between now and seven days after now, inclusive at both ends.

tasks.title: Calculate a checked invoice line total

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Require quantity greater than zero and price nonnegative; multiply Int64 minor units with checked arithmetic.
Return true iff status is Open and total minor units are positive.
Require a nonblank reference and an exact match to the requested positive amount.
Use the reference constructor: reject whitespace-only subject/body with INVALID_EMAIL_MESSAGE and trim accepted fields.

tasks.title: Validate an email address under the fixture policy

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Match the exact bounded ASCII policy in docs/BUSINESS.md, including its 254-character maximum; do not claim full RFC validation.

tasks.title: Check whether a subscription can be cancelled at an instant

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Return true iff Active and cancellation time is not earlier than start; equality is allowed.
Return true iff Active and expiry is less than or equal to the supplied instant.
Apply the 10% premium-only discount with integer truncation; leave regular totals unchanged.

tasks.title: Check whether an invoice contains lines

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Return true for one or more lines and false for an empty list.

tasks.title: Compare customer identifiers by GUID identity

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Compare parsed CustomerId values, not spelling; F# accepts Guid.TryParse forms and formats lowercase D.

tasks.title: Find a subscription by nominal ID

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Search the full collection by ID; return the matching record or None without changing Store.
Replace exactly the matching ID in place, preserving other records/order; missing ID returns SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND unchanged.
Return Active subscriptions in the inclusive seven-day window, preserving source-list order.
Queue one reminder per eligible subscription; preserve FIFO and do not duplicate queued or sent reminders.
Apply the reminder transition twice and retain exactly one queued/sent message per eligible subscription.

requiredPublicContract.signature: Store SubscriptionId Instant Instant -> Result<Store, BusinessError>
requiredPublicContract.behavior: Copy customer/product/term from an eligible source; use supplied dates, require expiry after start, reject duplicate IDs.

requiredPublicContract.signature: Store InvoiceId CustomerId List<CartLine> Instant -> Result<Store, BusinessError>
requiredPublicContract.behavior: Create all-or-nothing, snapshot product details, check line totals, then discount the invoice total once.

tasks.title: Reject an invalid cart without partial invoice state

requiredPublicContract.signature: Store InvoiceId CustomerId List<CartLine> Instant -> Result<Store, BusinessError>
requiredPublicContract.behavior: Validate every cart line and total before publishing; a late invalid line leaves Store unchanged.

tasks.title: Sum open invoice balances for one customer

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Sum Open invoices for that customer with checked Int64 addition; ignore paid invoices and other customers.

tasks.title: List outstanding invoices for one customer

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Return only Open invoices for that customer in deterministic projection order.

tasks.title: Apply an exact successful payment receipt

requiredPublicContract.signature: Store PaymentId InvoiceId Money PaymentReceipt Instant -> Result<Store, BusinessError>
requiredPublicContract.behavior: On a positive exact receipt for an Open invoice, record one payment and mark Paid; mismatch/already-paid leave state unchanged.

requiredPublicContract.signature: Store PaymentId InvoiceId Money Result<PaymentReceipt, BusinessError> Instant -> Result<Store, BusinessError>
requiredPublicContract.behavior: Propagate provider Error by stable code and leave invoice/payment state unchanged.

tasks.title: Deliver the FIFO email at the head of the queue

requiredPublicContract.behavior: On success remove exactly the first queued message and append it to sent emails, preserving order.

tasks.title: Keep the FIFO head when email delivery fails

requiredPublicContract.behavior: A delivery Error returns EMAIL_PROVIDER_FAILURE and leaves both FIFO lists unchanged.

tasks.title: Add a customer with duplicate-ID protection

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Add immutably; reject an existing nominal CustomerId with DUPLICATE_CUSTOMER and preserve state/order.

tasks.title: Cancel active subscriptions for one customer

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Cancel only that customer's Active subscriptions; retain others/order. Any invalid cancellation rejects the whole transition.
Return stable sorted findings for subscriptions/invoices with missing customer or product references; do not mutate Store.

tasks.title: Aggregate paid amounts for one customer

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Sum recorded payments linked through invoices to the customer using checked Int64 addition.
Return payments for that invoice ordered by paid-at then normalized PaymentId; do not mutate Store.

tasks.title: Create a premium annual renewal package

requiredPublicContract.signature: Store SubscriptionId Instant InvoiceId -> Result<Store, BusinessError>
requiredPublicContract.behavior: Compose eligibility, premium annual discount, invoice, successor subscription, and one reminder; any failed step preserves input Store.
Restore the ordinal Kind rule and preserve other customer behavior.
Restore the 10% premium discount with integer minor-unit arithmetic; preserve regular balances.
Return true only for exact "annual"; do not make monthly or case variants annual.
Apply Active status and both inclusive seven-day bounds exactly.
A second cancellation returns SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_CANCELLED and leaves timestamp/state unchanged.
Exclude cancelled subscriptions inside the time window; preserve eligible active entries.
Reject cancellation before start but allow equality and later instants.

tasks.title: Repair a list traversal that skips an endpoint

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Visit every entry exactly once, including first and last, while retaining source order.
On provider error retain the entire outbox and sent list unchanged.
Use checked Int64 multiplication, return MONEY_OVERFLOW, and publish no invoice state.

tasks.title: Share premium classification across customer operations

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Extract one typed predicate; route discount-rate and discounted-balance operations through it without behavior changes.

tasks.title: Share renewal eligibility across queries and reminders

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Extract shared status/time logic; use it in candidate listing and reminder scheduling.

tasks.title: Share checked line arithmetic across invoice paths

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Route invoice creation and summary through one checked multiplication helper; retain atomic error behavior.
Route time-window checks through one instant comparison helper; normalize offsets and preserve each boundary policy.
Use one lookup word from cancellation, renewal, and replacement paths without changing missing-ID behavior.

tasks.title: Share receipt validation across payment entry points

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Route direct and result-provider paths through one pure receipt validator; keep failures atomic.
Use one constructor from direct queue and renewal-reminder creation; preserve trim and error rules.
Build total aggregation from the shared selection word so customer/status filtering agrees.

tasks.title: Share payment aggregation by invoice owner

requiredPublicContract.behavior: Use one owner-resolution and checked-sum path for account and dashboard summaries.

tasks.title: Route package workflows through one renewal operation

requiredPublicContract.signature: Store SubscriptionId Instant InvoiceId -> Result<Store, BusinessError>
requiredPublicContract.behavior: Replace duplicated premium/annual renewal sequences with one shared package operation used by one-at-a-time and batch entry points.
